observedFailureModes: one visual dependency batch returned a single candidate array instead of a case-keyed object
raw coordinates, opaque communities, degrees, and candidate adjacency did not improve aggregate ranking on Qwen3-4B

studyClass.reason: All 54 query outcomes were exposed by v2. This follow-up may diagnose representation and format reliability on the same corpus, but it cannot provide a fresh confirmatory superiority claim.

dataset.confirmationRequirement: Use a newly authored, independently annotated external-codebase corpus whose labels and outcomes were not available while designing v3.

arms.description: Question plus compact candidate cards containing paths and at most four symbol names.
The same cards plus the v2 raw topology projection: positions, opaque communities, degrees, and candidate adjacency.
The same cards plus a query-adaptive relational projection with explicit import direction, external degree, community peers, and bounded graph-role summaries; coordinates are excluded.

design.candidateConstruction: Reuse the v2 label-blind controlled-navigation construction: include every source-audited relevant file, then fill with HoloEmbed GraphRAG hard negatives that resolve to canonical CodebaseSceneCompiler nodes.
design.candidateScopeBoundary: Every relevant file is inserted into the candidate set, so this measures selection and ranking from a bounded view, not end-to-end retrieval recall.
design.counterbalancing: Generate one deterministic candidate permutation per query and rotate it across arms with a query-derived offset. Arm request order is independently rotated per batch and trial.
design.promptInjectionBoundary: Raw source bodies, doc comments, and signatures are excluded. Candidate evidence is limited to normalized paths, symbol names, and generated graph metadata.

responseSchema.answers: object with exactly one required property per query ID
responseSchema.rankedCandidateIds: array of one to five unique candidate aliases in descending relevance order

engineeringGate.interpretation: On the known development corpus, v3 may pass only the execution and format gate. Accuracy estimates and intervals are diagnostic and cannot support a superiority claim.

claimBoundary.measuredSurface: agent-readable structured projections of the canonical visual graph
claimBoundary.reason: The dataset is outcome-exposed and the relational arm was designed in response to v2. A successful v3 engineering run would establish format reliability and motivate confirmation only.
claimBoundary.nextVisionGate: Render the identical candidate subgraph to a fixed screenshot or interactive viewport and evaluate it with a vision-capable agent on a newly held-out external corpus.
